entries.055d8c66e5303920: A business that develops, manufactures and sells semiconductor inspection equipment and LCD inspection equipment. Semiconductor inspection equipment includes testers, manual and semi-automatic wafer probers, and package probes (test sockets) used for inspection after assembly. The company is promoting sales of the new tester "Testalio" and the manual prober "Excelyze". Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥1,648 million.

entries.b2c4e5e27f69e27c: A business that develops, manufactures and sells probe cards, which are semiconductor measurement tools. In the wafer inspection process of semiconductor manufacturing, probe cards play a role similar to a connector: pins make contact with the electrodes of semiconductor chips on a silicon wafer, linking the tester and the chips. In addition to the company, Kunshan Maikexin Microelectronics Co., Ltd. in China and MEK Co.,Ltd. in Korea manufacture and sell products, and subsidiaries in the United States, Germany, Taiwan and Singapore handle sales and maintenance. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥68,525 million.
